name: Banneret (Marshal Archetype)
body:
The banneret is a marshal who has many other warriors under their banner. They are accompanied by their standard-bearer and eventually, a full retinue.

Standard-bearer (Ex)

At 1st level, a banneret gains the service of a standard-bearer that carries their standard and acts as their squire. This functions as a cohort from the Leadership feat except as follows:

At 1st and 2nd levels, this cohort is a 1st-level warrior and cannot level up.
At 3rd level, this cohort exchanges their warrior level for a level in a class that grants proficiency in all martial weapons and they cannot multi-class until 7th level. The cohort cannot be a marshal.

The standard-bearer gains Swift Aid as a bonus feat, and provides a +2 (rather than +1) bonus when using this feat to aid the banneret. As a move action, the standard-bearer can retrieve a stored item or an item on the ground and hand it to the banneret. The banneret does not have to take an action to receive the item, though they must be conscious and have a free hand.

This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity for the standard-bearer or banneret.

If a standard-bearer dies, or is released from the banneret’s service, the banneret may gain a new standard-bearer by scouting for potential candidates in a city or large town. This requires 1 day per 5 levels of the standardbearer to be recruited.

At 7th level, the banneret gains Leadership as a bonus feat and need not meet the prerequisites. Their standard-bearer must remain as their cohort however.

This ability replaces inspire action.

Raise the Standard (Ex)

At 1st level, all of the banneret’s auras are centered on the standard-bearer, and only when they are conscious and wielding a polearm weapon with your standard attached. If the standard-bearer is unconscious or dead, the banneret can take up the standard and have the auras centered on them.

This ability modifies auras. At 7th level, the allies need only see the standard or hear the banneret to be affected by auras or tactician.

This ability replaces inspiring voice.

Teamwork (Ex)

At 2nd level, as long as a banneret and their standard-bearer are within 10 feet, the standard-bearer is treated as having any teamwork feats the banneret possesses. They also share any teamwork feats that function when two or more allies threaten the same target, as long as they both threaten the same target.

This ability replaces vital inspiration.
